summary: Sales/SE unable to log into Standard Demo tenant (SSO/RBAC) — 403 'org membership required'
description:
Issue summary:
Multiple Sales/SE users report they cannot access the Standard Demo tenant in Console. Login succeeds via SSO, but landing in Console shows error: "403: org membership required" and the tenant selector does not show "Redwood Demo (ri-demo)".

Who is impacted:
- NA AEs/SEs prepping for customer demos this week.
- At least 7 users confirmed in Slack; likely broader given field rollout.

Business impact:
- Live demos blocked unless an already-provisioned user drives.
- Increased risk of last-minute demo failure / SE heroics.

Notes:
This appears limited to the demo tenant org membership/RBAC, not a general Console outage. Users can access their usual internal org(s).
steps_to_reproduce:
1) User signs into Console via SSO (Okta) at https://console.redwoodinference.com
2) Attempt to select the Standard Demo tenant org "ri-demo" (if visible)
3) If not visible, navigate directly to https://console.redwoodinference.com/org/ri-demo
4) Observe error banner and/or redirect to "Request access" page

Observed for:
- Users newly added to Sales enablement rollout list
- Users with valid Redwood email + Okta SSO
expected_result: Eligible field users should see "Redwood Demo (ri-demo)" in org selector and be assigned DemoTenantUser role with read/write on Routes + Dashboards and read on Audit Logs.
actual_result: Login completes, but user is not a member of ri-demo org. Direct navigation returns 403 "org membership required". In some cases the UI suggests "Request access" but the request flow is disabled for ri-demo.
impact: P1 internal: prevents field team from running the Standard Demo v1 independently. Workarounds exist (shared driver / already-provisioned SE), but not acceptable for ongoing enablement.
investigation_notes:
Initial hypotheses:
- Okta group not mapped to ri-demo org membership
- SCIM provisioning not creating org membership for ri-demo
- JIT provisioning disabled for ri-demo (preventing first-time membership)
- RBAC role assignment missing even if membership is present

Findings:
- Affected users exist in Console user directory but have no org membership row for org=ri-demo.
- Okta group "sales-demo-tenant" exists, but mapping in Identity service points to org slug "demo" (legacy) not "ri-demo".
- ri-demo org has JIT provisioning set to "off" (intentional originally), so even corrected group membership would not auto-attach existing users without backfill.
- No evidence of platform-wide auth failures; other org access OK.

Data points:
- Console audit event for failed access: "authz_denied_org_membership".
- Time correlation: started after Standard Demo v1 tenant recreation last week (new org slug ri-demo). Legacy mapping not updated.
workaround:
Short-term (for demos today):
- Use an already-provisioned driver (e.g., Markus Klein / Simran Kaur) to share screen and run the Console clickpath.
- If absolutely required, use the shared "demo-driver" account stored in 1Password (restricted, time-boxed). Ensure no browser password save.

Short-term (for individual users):
- Admin can manually add users to ri-demo and assign role "DemoTenantUser" via internal admin panel: /admin/orgs/ri-demo/members.
resolution:
Fixed mapping and backfilled membership.

Actions taken:
1) Updated Okta group mapping in Identity service from legacy org slug "demo" to "ri-demo".
2) Ran backfill script to attach existing Okta-group members to org ri-demo and assign RBAC role "DemoTenantUser".
3) Enabled "Request access" for ri-demo (internal-only) to allow future self-serve requests if group membership lags.
4) Verified with 3 reporters (Sales/SE) that tenant appears in org selector and Routes/Dashboards pages load.

Rollout/verification:
- Verified in prod us-east; no config change required on client side.
- Monitoring: watched authz_denied_org_membership events return to baseline for 30 minutes post-change.
root_cause: Demo tenant org slug changed during Standard Demo v1 tenant recreation (legacy "demo" -> "ri-demo"), but Okta-to-org mapping in Identity service was not updated. JIT provisioning was disabled for ri-demo, preventing automatic membership creation and amplifying the impact.
follow_ups:
1) Add a demo-tenant recreation checklist item: "Update IdP group mapping and validate 3 field users can log in" (owner: Rafael Mendes).
2) Add automated smoke check in weekly demo regression: verify Okta group member can access ri-demo and load Dashboards (owner: Amara Diallo).
3) Update internal enablement email to include the correct access request path + expected turnaround (owner: Talia Benson).
4) Consider enabling JIT provisioning for ri-demo with guardrails (Okta-group-only) to avoid future drift (owner: Marcus Lin).
related_github_prs: N/A (config-only change in Identity service; no PR)
